summary: The candidate is a partial fix. It moves the HiCache hand-over to run_batch and stages pure-prefill input_ids plus extend and DP metadata before the burst, but deliberately leaves mixed prefill+decode input_ids on the deferred forward-entry path. An independent probe observed the burst hand-over before that H2D upload, violating the original issue's round-head ordering contract for ForwardMode.MIXED.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate regression could not import StagedDeviceTensor on the recorded base; independent source inspection also confirmed ready_to_load_host_cache occurred before prepare_for_extend.
All 21 candidate ordering and staging unit tests passed.
All 56 candidate and neighboring focused tests passed.
Observed ['burst_handover', 'input_ids_h2d'] for a mixed prefill+decode batch, proving the deferred prefill input_ids H2D is still issued after the burst hand-over.

tests.command: prepared Python inline torch.cuda _stage pinned-H2D check (candidate commit)
tests.what_was_measured: On the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, staged [3, 5, 8] through a nonblocking host-to-device copy and verified one-shot consumption.

gpu_execution.evidence: One real pinned nonblocking H2D staging check passed on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2. This did not reproduce the reported NVIDIA copy-engine timing.

remaining_counterexamples: For ForwardMode.MIXED with mix_running_indices present, pre_upload_forward_inputs leaves prefill_input_ids_cpu deferred. _handover_hicache_load then calls ready_to_load_host_cache, and resolve_forward_inputs later performs prefill_input_ids_cpu.to(device, non_blocking=True), so this round-head H2D remains ordered after the burst hand-over.
No H100 TP=8 multi-GiB HiCache trace demonstrates that the remaining mixed-batch upload avoids the reported copy-engine stall; the deterministic call order instead shows that it can still be exposed.
remaining_limitations: The available machine had one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), not 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs, and no qualifying large-model hierarchical-cache workload or weights. Therefore H100 copy-engine arbitration, TP=8 all-reduce delay, multi-GiB burst timing, and end-to-end performance were not reproduced. No native C++ changed, so no native rebuild was applicable. Source imports resolved to /job/repo/python/sglang; Torch/ROCm remained intact.
